messages:
emily: RFC follow-up — packaging strategy for on-prem installs. We debated full repo snapshots (.deb/apt style) vs chunked tar streaming with on-node verifier. Which direction do we take for constrained air-gapped installs?

raj: leaning streaming + signed manifest. Lower disk spike, resumable over flaky links, easier to fetch large model blobs in chunks. :thumbsup:

lina: Operator UX flag — streaming makes partial state visible. We need a clear staging -> activate flow and a documented rollback playbook. Also how do we handle deltas for huge model files? :thinking:

tom: verification question — can the verifier work without loading entire files in RAM? We hit verifier OOM on 2GB QA boxes last month.

emily: proposal: verifier incremental-verify stream. Hash each chunk, write to a temp dir, only on complete verification do an atomic rename into place. avoids full-file memory. Example manifest (minimal):
```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "artifact": "redwood-model-v3",
  "chunks": [
    {"path": "chunks/0000", "sha256": "...", "size": 1048576},
    {"path": "chunks/0001", "sha256": "...", "size": 1048576}
  ],
  "signatures": ["sig-v1-base64"],
  "compat_matrix": {"rwi": ">=1.8", "k8s": ">=1.21"}
}
```

raj: add `compat_matrix` is great — operator can pre-check runtime and refuse activation if mismatch. Also store `recovery_points` metadata for fast rollback.

pkg-bot: pkg-bot: artifact uploaded to staging-registry (sha256:abc123...). Registry URL: file://staging.local/artifacts/redwood-model-v3

lina: Rollback playbook idea: keep last 3 activated artifacts and metadata; on failed post-activate healthcheck within N minutes auto-revert. Document the healthcheck hook and make it pluggable per-customer.

tom: fs-level concern: partial apply + sudden power loss can leave symlinks pointing to incomplete dirs. Implementation rule: write into versioned dir (e.g., /opt/rwi/artifacts/v3-<sha>), fsync files, then `rename()` symlink to point to new dir and fsync parent dir. That gives atomic switch semantics.

emily: agree. Also propose an `apply_window` operator config to avoid activations during business hours for critical infra. And expose `applyDryRun()` via operator API so SRE can validate before flipping.

devex: I'll add a quickstart and CLI snippet to docs for offline installs and verifier behavior. Can someone drop a minimal CLI example to wire into the installer templates?

raj: example CLI: `rwi-installer --stream-from file://bundle.tar --manifest bundle.manifest --verify --activate`  — verifier does incremental checks and only performs activate after full verification. :shipit:

emily: next steps: update RFC with manifest schema, verifier memory/perf profile, rollback playbook, operator API and CLI. I'll kick off infra perf tests for streaming vs full repo pulls and tag the results. Thanks all. :tada:
